name: Mat
description: Material-tactile presentation system. Dark forest green canvas with warm wood-brown atmospheric glow from bottom-right. Cream type floats on the field; burnt-orange single accent. Bricolage Grotesque display (mixed case, never uppercase), DM Sans body, DM Mono labels. Cream info-card inset is the signature material-contrast move.
descriptionZh: 质感材料演示系统。深森林绿底色，右下角暖木棕氛围辉光。奶油色文字浮于底色之上，燃橙色单色强调。Bricolage Grotesque 展示字体（混合大小写，永不大写），DM Sans 正文，DM Mono 标签。奶油色信息卡嵌入为标志性材质对比手法。
avoidFor: 需要快速科技能量或体制约束的场景
高视觉冲击力的信息传达
